brief:
WAVE-2b AS BUILT (binding; every PVM: anchor below is at tip 52be6ef -- re-grep): `PlaybackEngineSession` (Engine/PlaybackEngineSession.swift, 663 lines, plain non-isolated `final class` -- NOT @MainActor, see design 2.8 wave-2b block): `loadID`, `plan`, `backend: any PlaybackBackend`, `surfaceBackend: AVPlayerBackend?`, `transport: PlaybackSourceProxy?`, `driver: RecoveryDriver`, `events: AsyncStream<EngineEvent>` (unbounded, one continuation; `bindBackend()` converts the 17 backend closures into yields), `init(loadID:plan:backendFactory:reusing:sourceCacheHandoff:)` -- on backend reuse it adopts the outgoing driver's `suspendedReasons` AND `context.outage` together (the rule: a hold may only be adopted together with its releaser), non-throwing `start(startSeconds:)`, non-async `perform(_ action: RecoveryAction)` (in-route arms synchronous on the backend; the two vod-stall arms hop via Task{@MainActor} deliberately -- round-2 repair), `seek`, `retargetSource(url:headers:)`, `stopTransport()`, `prepareSource(...)` (owns proxy construction incl. `setSourceBitrate` + `startPrefetch`; behaviour-identical port of legacy prepareSourceProxy), `dispose(reason:)`, `dispose(retainingTransport: Bool)` (tvOS suspend keeps the proxy), `disposeEngineOnly(reason:)` (keeps the session alive as the load's recovery owner AND does not finish the events stream; also runs `unbindBackend()`), `detachBackendForDisposal()`. Shell-executed recovery actions arrive as `EngineEvent.recoveryAction(RecoveryAction)` (the ONLY EngineEvent case wave 2b added -- design 2.3 as-built item 9; observations never leave the session). `RecoveryDriver` (Recovery/RecoveryDriver.swift, 445 lines, non-isolated, one per session/LoadID) is the ONLY runtime caller of `RecoveryPolicy.decide`: `observe(_:now:)`, `setSuspended(_:reason:)` (reference-counted by reason; replaces BOTH legacy latches), `adoptSuspensions(_:)`, `adoptOutageRideThrough(_:)`, `note(userPaused:)/note(playbackEstablished:)/note(mediaTimelineOffset:)/...`, `armStartupLadder`, `clearServerOutageRecovery()`. PlayerViewModel as of 2b: `consumeEngineEvents(of:)` installs ONE task per session under `tasks[.engineEvents]` and `apply(_:from:)` is guarded by `engineSession === session && pendingLoadID == session.loadID && !session.isDisposed` (identity, not generations); `executeRecoveryAction(_:session:)` (PVM ~1265-1339) is the shell executor for `.recoveryAction`; `runOutageRideThrough` re-resolves `self.engineSession` EVERY turn (owner check before the probe, current after) -- this is what makes the origin_outage hold releasable across an in-place replan; `performServerOutageRecovery` releases the hold as its FIRST statement, before the bail that also clears the single-flight; `sourceOutageRideThroughTask` is still registry-keyed (`.sourceOutageRideThrough`, scopes [.teardown,.sessionRecovery]). OWNERSHIP RULES wave 3 must not break: LocalHLSHost stays owned by `AVPlayerBackend.loopbackHost` (session owns it transitively -- do NOT lift it onto the actor or session); `carriedVODPlan` stays on the backend; the subtitle tap stays backend-owned (source-keyed, outlives sessions). ALREADY DELETED by 2b (do not re-list, the greps are satisfied at base): makeCallbacks/applyCallbacks/wireSubtitleCallbacks, the by-value generation guards, the recovery handshake (setRecoverySuspended/setExternalStallSuppression/kickPlaybackAfterExternalStallCleared), watchdogReanchor*/didEscalateLoopbackStall/loopbackEdgeWatch/loopbackRebuildBudget/pendingLocalLoopbackRecoveryMediaTime, hasAttemptedNativeDirectRouteRecovery/hasAttemptedSiloRouteHLSFallback (context flags now), sourceOutageActive, and the two OUTAGE session-id echoes. STILL LIVE and deleted by THIS wave: streamLoadGeneration remnants, freshLoadGeneration, serverOutageRecoveryGeneration, staleSessionRecoverySessionId, backgroundRenewalSessionId, activeServerOutageRecoverySessionId, activePlaybackSessionId, isCurrentStreamCallback, hasReachedEndOfFile (-> .ended), suspendedPlayback/playbackInterruption fields (-> reducer state per as-built item 8), the private PlayerViewModel.LoadOrigin (as-built item 4 -- the ControlPlane copy already exists; delete the private one).

WAVE 3 -- one package, one implementer (effort max): PlaybackSessionActor runs PlaybackReducer; PlayerViewModel becomes the presentation model.
STEP 1. ControlPlane/PlaybackSessionActor.swift -- `actor PlaybackSessionActor` with `state`, `send(_ intent: PlayerIntent)`, `ingest(_ event: PlayerEvent)`; runs Effects AS BUILT in 1E (re-read PlaybackState.swift/PlaybackReducer.swift first; the sketch's effect list drifted -- notably `transport(TransportCommand, LoadID)`, `syncProgress(...)` completed BEFORE the following startSession, `disposeEngine(LoadID, sourceCache: .stash|.discard|.retainProxy)` which maps 1:1 onto the session's dispose/dispose(retainingTransport:)/disposeEngineOnly + the shell's stash/discard handoff sites): startSession (bridge or OfflinePlaybackBuilder, emits .session events with the bridge's identity), stopSession(expected identity), loadEngine (PlaybackEngineSession with `reusing` on reuseEngine), disposeEngine (with disposition), seek, replan/renewSource (bridge), runRecovery (session.perform), pollServerHealth/schedule/cancelTimer (owns PlayerTaskRegistry's control-plane keys incl. .engineEvents and .sourceOutageRideThrough), reportProgress/FirstFrame/PlanExecutionStarted, publish (MERGE onto the @MainActor presentation sink -- contract note (f); coalesced per tick for the high-frequency arms per note (g); NEVER synthesise pauseChanged -- note (h)). The engine session's `events` stream is consumed BY THE ACTOR (one registered task per LoadID, replacing the VM's consumeEngineEvents/apply): each EngineEvent is stamped with the session's LoadID and ingested; `.recoveryAction` becomes `PlayerEvent.recovery(RecoveryAction, LoadID)` and its execution arms port from `executeRecoveryAction` into effects. The ride-through poll becomes an actor-owned effect loop that (as today) re-resolves the live session each turn and feeds `.serverHealthProbe(ok:)` into that session's driver.
STEP 2. Move LoadOrigin: delete the private PlayerViewModel.LoadOrigin; `LoadRequest` moves to ControlPlane/LoadRequest.swift with `adoptingProtocolV3Intent` intact (as-built item 5: the replay request is adopted at .prepared/.replanned/.renewed -- port the two preconditions and the pre-adopt quality latch); retarget the 4 test sites.
STEP 3. PlayerViewModel: delete the control core -- beginFreshLoad, runStartSession, disposeActivePlayerForFreshLoad/disposePlayerOffMain/OneShotContinuation, adoptPreparedPlayback + PlaybackAdoptionOrigin (the adopt's overlay raise stays in the shell per contract note (d)), loadStream, makeExecutionPlan (-> actor), attemptProtocolV3Replan/restartCurrentTranscodeHLS (-> ReplanIntent; keep the pre-adopt quality latch semantics), the renewal/outage EXECUTION bodies attemptBackgroundSessionRenewal/attemptStaleSessionRenewal/attemptServerOutageRecovery/waitForServerReady/probeServerHealthOnce/runOutageRideThrough (-> effects; the driver plumbing from 2b ports with them), finalizeTerminalPlaybackError (-> .failed + publish; as-built item 3: identity/playhead/request/selections carried, no .stopSession), handleEndOfFile control parts (it hand-writes isPaused -- as-built item 7 names the three legal hand-writers), commitSeek/beginReanchorSeekUI/reloadServerBackedHLSForSeek/reloadLocalLoopbackForSeekBeforeAnchor (-> .seek intent; the seek-past-anchor first branch has NO reducer model -- contract note (e) and obligation 1: wave 3 writes this as reducer rules, not a passthrough), handleScenePhase (-> .scenePhase intent; the iOS PiP grace resolves in the shell first -- note (b)), suspendForBackground/resumeSuspendedPlayback (-> reducer; dispose maps to .retainProxy), consumeEngineEvents/apply (-> actor), executeRecoveryAction (-> effects), and the identity fields listed in the as-built paragraph above. KEEP: every member in inventory-4 B.2 with the same name (as projections of Presentation or intent forwarders), NowPlaying/Next-Up/markers/sleep timer/controls/scrub/hold-seek/notices/settings glue, the realtime client + SiloControl projection (makeSiloControlPlaybackState reads Presentation), the AVAudioSession route observer (forwards .outputRouteChanged; the hasProtocolV3 guard per as-built item 6), the track coordinator (ports read actor snapshots and send intents; the shell keeps TrackResumeSelections current incl. the -1 sentinel and re-arms resolvers at each adopt -- note (c) + obligation 4), qualityOptions stays presentation-only (obligation 5), the pre-V3 switchQuality branches stay in the shell which issues its own .load (obligation 2).
STEP 4. NowPlaying handlers and SiloControl commands -> intents (.play/.pause/.seek).
STEP 5. CLOSE THE TWO 2b-DISCLOSED GAPS with actor-scoped state (both RESTORE legacy; list them in behavior_changes as restorations): (a) the post-outage-reload error/EOF suppression window -- the gate becomes actor state that survives into the replacement load and releases at the replacement's fileLoaded (legacy activeServerOutageRecoverySessionId semantics; 2b behavior_changes item 8); (b) ride-through state becomes actor-scoped so a ROUTE-CHANGE replan during an outage keeps the original 90 s deadline and re-entry stays a no-op while active (design 2.8 wave-2b block, disclosed divergence; the in-place-replan carry from 2b keeps working -- the actor state subsumes adoptOutageRideThrough). Also obligation 3: the outage-recovery suppression release is an explicit effect now that the engine session survives via disposeEngineOnly (2b already releases first in performServerOutageRecovery -- port as an effect, do not lose it).
STEP 6. PlaybackSessionActorTests over FakePlaybackBackend + FakePlaybackTransport (fresh load; in-place replan reuse keeps backend AND adopted holds+outage; stale event ignored; second replan dropped; background renewal single-flight; outage ride-through incl. route-change-preserves-deadline and suppression-window-release-at-fileLoaded; scene-phase tables via ScenePhasePlatform parameter; suspend/resume with .retainProxy; dispose cancels timers; progress cadence; seek-past-anchor rule). Port/rewrite the 2b tests that pinned VM-owned behaviour the actor now owns (PlaybackEngineSessionTests reuse/suspension tests stay -- session API unchanged). Full suite on a cloned sim + same-host control at base. Build all three schemes.
STEP 7. Greps (0 hits in iosApp/iosApp): see deletions.

HARD BOUNDARIES: no edits to RecoveryPolicy/RecoveryContext/RecoveryObservation/RecoveryAction decision content (frozen since 1B; additive shell-need changes require a skipped-with-evidence report); no edits to LocalHLSHost, LoopbackSegmentWriter/Store/Server, ISOBoxSurgery, subtitle renderer, writer mux internals; PlaybackEngineSession's public surface may gain what the actor needs but its ownership rules (host/carriedVODPlan/tap backend-owned) stand; every effect carries LoadID/SessionIdentity and every mutation is conditional on it; the single-writer rule for isPaused (as-built item 7 + note (h)); views must not change (inventory-4 B.2 names are binding).
